_note: C6 joints and fasteners: local specification values (hardware dimensions from the ISO standards, torques and rules chosen by C6). Read by team/C6/joints.py as P:joints.*. Revision C6-R5 (params A1-R5, D-50, D-58, D-68, D-70; C4 frozen R4 set). Shared numbers come from params/params.json and the subsystem params; loads come from C1 claims. Frame and units: params.json#frame, SI.

m3_d_m.note: every bought structural fastener is M3 (one thread, one 2.5 mm hex key)

nyloc_protrusion_min_threads.note: bolt end at least 2 pitches past the nyloc nut

insert_len_m.source: Ruthex RX-M3x5.7 / CNC Kitchen M3 standard insert
insert_len_m.note: hole 4.0 mm, blind depth >= engagement + 0.5 mm, boss wall >= 1.6 mm

insert_engage_min_d.note: x d into a heat-set insert; 1.0 d into metal; 2.0 d self-tapping into plastic

motor_screw_nm.note: M3 into the aluminium motor base, head on a printed plate, no washer; 4 N (0.41 kg) on a luggage scale hooked 50 mm out on the hex key

insert_nm.note: M3 into a brass heat-set insert in PETG; insert torque-out is several times higher

printed_max_nm.note: ceiling for any M3 whose head or nut bears on a printed part

nylon_m3_nm.note: PA66 M3 into a brass insert: 1.6 N on a luggage scale 50 mm out on the hex key, or fingertip-snug on a PH1 until the washer stops turning; replaces F1's 0.20 N m (install RF 0.67 at 0.20). No threadlocker on nylon

strip_bonded_faces_now.note: R3: both strip faces bond to PETG in the 40 mm two-face tail (tongue between the strips)

fillet_leg_m.note: microballoon-epoxy fillet leg in the pod floor-to-side-wall corner under the strap

stack_m.note: clamped length above the insert face

spacer_m.source: subsystems/power/interfaces.json E-PWR-03 (nylon spacer OD 6 / ID 3.2 / 10 mm)

collar_alt_h_m.source: subsystems/fins/params.json R3 (16 mm ring); CHANGE-LOG D-48
collar_alt_h_m.note: fallback height if T-C6-LAP-PETG comes in below 2.0 MPa design or C1's torsion grows; the drawn height is fin_detail.station_collar.height_m (13 mm, D-70)

root_fillet_leg_m.note: half-fin root microballoon fillet leg, both faces; D3 draws 15 mm over the effective root (zoned, CR-D3-25: 13 mm aft of the hinge, 6 mm bead ahead); C6 accepts the zoning

pin_pitch_prop_m.note: 15 mm with 2.5 mm pins, drawn since D3-R5 (D-70)

pin_d_prop_m.note: pultruded CF rod 2.5 mm (stock size), drawn since D3-R5 (D-70); bending capacity x (2.5/2)^3 = 1.95 vs 2 mm

pin_pitch_alt_m.note: fallback if 2.5 mm rod cannot be bought: 2 mm pins at 9 mm pitch

collar_min_h_m.note: 13 mm, drawn since D3-R5 (D-70); kept as a named check height so the claim id CL-C6-COLLAR-RF-13MM stays stable

collar_cond_h_m.note: 12 mm collar allowed only if T-C6-LAP-PETG mean >= 4.1 MPa before the collars print (CL-C6-COLLAR-RF-12MM-COND)

collar_cond_tau_pa.note: bond allowable that would release the 12 mm collar

pin_d_alt_m.note: 2 mm CF rod at pin_pitch_alt_m only if 2.5 mm rod cannot be bought

bondline_max_m.source: C6 rule (30 min epoxy / microballoon gap fill)
bondline_max_m.note: largest unfilled gap accepted at a bonded fit; beyond it pack with microballoon mix

pocket_bead_leg_m.note: microballoon bead leg along the inboard and outboard block-pocket edges, both surfaces

pocket_beads_per_block.note: inboard + outboard pocket edges x upper + lower surface

collar_prop_h_m.note: C6-R5b ask: 15 -> 22 mm. C1's D-65 re-run raised the half-fin section torsion 8.13 -> 12.67 N m (limit); the collar needs 19.45 mm at the 2.0 MPa allowable (CL-C6-COLLAR-L-REQ); 22 mm gives RF 1.13. Ring grows down to |z| 0.1375; ear and brace end unchanged. ~+4.2 g for four vs 15 mm (EST). Was 15 (CR-C6-36)
